def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text.strip('"').strip().replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "")
    return ""


def extract_features(texts, vectorizer_dict=None):
    word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        max_features=50000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=False,
    )
    word_features = word_vectorizer.fit_transform([clean_text(t) for t in texts])

    char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(1, 3), max_features=15000, lowercase=True
    )
    char_features = char_vectorizer.fit_transform([clean_text(t) for t in texts])

    combined_features = hstack([word_features, char_features])
    return combined_features, word_vectorizer, char_vectorizer
